integrity: The claim is proved by an exact two-dimensional Hermitian spectral reduction and an elementary integral. No numerical experiment, incomplete enumeration, or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nonzero rank-one operators on complex Hilbert spaces.

title: Exact rank-one overlap profile for the \(L^2\)-Cartesian numerical radius
